title: Steer Model beyond Assistant: Controlling System Prompt Strength via Contrastive Decoding

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluated using the Prompt-Steering benchmark, which measures the model's ability to shift its stance on profiling questions related to political views when provided with specific persona statements in the system prompt.

Evaluated through a Readability Control task, which prompts the model to simulate writers of different ages (6, 12, 18, and 25 years old) and measures the output text's linguistic complexity using Flesch reading ease and Flesch-Kincaid grade level.
Evaluated using the Prompt-Steering benchmark, measuring how well the model can adopt diverse ethical and philosophical stances when instructed by persona-augmented system prompts.
